_help: days    : '3-6' range | '1,3,5' list | '2-8/2' every other | '4' one day
times   : M=Morning A=Afternoon E=Evening N=Night. Combine: 'M,A' or 'M,A,E,N'
move    : bare pattern name, or {pattern, speed, distance, axis, radius}
requires: 'beaten: NAME' | 'met: NAME' | 'flag: NAME', any prefixed with 'not '.
Compound gates use the longhand object form.
when    : optional rule list, evaluated TOP TO BOTTOM, FIRST MATCH WINS.
A rule states when the character is present plus ONLY what differs.
Anything a rule omits falls back to the character's own value above.
loop    : set false for story characters who must never repeat when the
calendar loops -- they are matched against the real day instead.
WHO IS BEHIND THE COUNTER alternates every day. The calendar below authors two
days and loops them from day 1 with a period of 2, so real day 1 is authored day
1, day 2 is day 2, day 3 is day 1 again, and so on for ever. Olly works the odd
days, Alexander the even ones -- swap the two 'days' values to flip that. They
share the shop_id 'fish_shop', so the stock is the same whoever is in.

says.meet: Morning! Fresh tackle, fresh fish. Want to see what we've got in?
says.repeat: Back again? Take a look at the shelves.

says.meet: Olly's got the day off, so you're stuck with me. Fancy a browse?
says.repeat: Still minding the shop. See anything you like?
